text:
Alice (release-lead): Quick heads-up — RC cutover in ~2h. Can folks do a fast green sweep? Need: merge version bump PR, changelog note for KV-cache fallback, and triage the flaky e2e/payment job failing in CI. If anything blocks cutover call it out now.

Ben (ci): On it. I queued a rerun for the failing pipeline. Job name: `e2e/payment (macos-12)`. Suspect `payment:session-expiry` flake. Will try a reproducible run and then quarantine if needed.

Carla (qa): I reproduced locally once — test times out at ~4.2s intermittently. Looks like a test harness race on session teardown. I'll open a small PR to add a short retry and better cleanup.

Dave (eng-ops): Quick reminder: use patch bump for RC (no major/minor). For JS projects: `npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git commit -am \"chore: bump to vX.Y.Z\"`. For Python: `poetry version patch`. Also ensure the Dedicated manifest image tag is updated before merge.

Ben (ci): If we need a hot workaround, I can add a conditional skip on mac runners while Carla's PR lands. Will mark the test flaky in CI and create a quarantine label.

Carla (qa): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821 — adds retry + cleanup and updates changelog under Unreleased: `Fix: stabilize payment session expiry test`. Also added a note to changelog: \"KV cache fallback fix - note about migration for older state stores\".

deploy-bot: build/4821 triggered by Carla. Status: queued.

Ben (ci): Quick snippet I used to mark quarantine in CI config:```yaml
jobs:
  e2e_payment:
    matrix:
      os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-12]
    skip_on: [macos-12]
``` Will revert once tests are stable.

Eve (qa-lead): Ran a staging smoke after Carla's local patch — baseline looks good. Canary window scheduled in 30m after merge, I'll run the long-e2e against canary.

Alice (release-lead): Perfect — plan: Ben toggles quarantine, Carla lands PR, Dave confirms manifest tag, I merge version bump after green, Eve runs canary. Cutoff in 1h45m. Ping here if anything slips. :thumbsup:

Ben (ci): Re-run passed except the same e2e on mac. Quarantine patch pushed to CI, creating issue to unquarantine later: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/issues/1902

Carla (qa): CI build green on linux+ubuntu, mac is skipped per quarantine. Merging PR now.

Dave (eng-ops): Manifest updated to `image: redwood/inference:v2.4.3` in `deploy/dedicated.yaml` and committed.

Alice (release-lead): Merged version bump PR and changelog update. Starting canary deploy in 10m. Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for cutover notes.

Eve (qa-lead): Canary smoke passed. No regressions. I'll sign off in 20m if production metrics look normal.

Alice (release-lead): Final call — any blockers? If not, I'll proceed with RC cutover at T+2h as planned.

Ben (ci): No blockers from CI side. :rocket:

Carla (qa): No further test flakes observed in canary run.

Alice (release-lead): Great — cutover in progress. Thanks everyone! :party:
